sources.entry: nltk - A leading platform for building Python programs to work with human language data.

summary.one_liner: NLTK is an open-source Python suite of modules, datasets, and tutorials for research and development in natural language processing.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes NLTK as a collection of open-source Python modules, data sets, and tutorials for Natural Language Processing research and development. It states that it requires Python 3.10 up to the latest 3.14. It points to nltk.org for documentation. The README also covers contributing guidelines (CONTRIBUTING.md), a donation link, a citation for the NLTK book by Bird, Loper and Klein (2009), and licensing terms. The README itself does not list specific NLP functions; those are documented on the external site.
use_cases: learning natural language processing with Python
academic research on human language data
working with linguistic corpora and datasets
notable: Suite of modules, datasets and tutorials in one project
Cited as the reference toolkit in the NLTK book (Bird, Loper, Klein)
Source code under Apache 2.0 with separate licenses for docs and corpora
caveats: Corpora are governed by per-corpus terms and many are for non-commercial use only
Documentation is external to the README (nltk.org)
Supports only Python 3.10 through 3.14 per the README
summary.license: Apache 2.0 (source code); documentation under CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 US; corpora under per-corpus terms
